facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Early- to mid-stage medical device, diagnostics, or digital health company；公司需位于 APAC 或计划进入 APAC。可同时申请 US 与 APAC，但每年只会被一个 program 录取。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: prototype / clinical or technical validation；regulatory pathway；APAC commercialization hypothesis；senior leader 可参加 program/finals。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 主体 virtual；包含 Asia-based finals / showcase 等线下节点。
facts_raw.International Founder: Yes — companies entering Asia-Pacific may apply
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 无需长期 relocation；参加 APAC finals/events 时需自行满足相应入境要求。
facts_raw.Deadline / Next Intake: Applications typically reopen in October for following year
facts_raw.Application Materials: MedTech Innovator application account；公司/产品/clinical-regulatory/commercialization/funding information。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: Official application / Contact Us; only trust @medtechinnovator.org or @innovator.org communications.
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: Medical device / diagnostics / digital health 公司，希望进入 Asia-Pacific 市场；early–mid stage。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 纯药物研发；无 medtech/diagnostic/digital health 产品；对 APAC 市场完全无兴趣。
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore 评价：适合想进入 APAC 的全球 medtech；如果目标是纯美国市场，优先 MTI US/VANTAGE。

facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Early to mid-stage medical device, diagnostics or digital health companies based in, or entering, APAC. Applicants may apply to both US and APAC programs but can join only one per year.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Prototype or clinical validation, a regulatory pathway, an APAC commercialization thesis and a senior leader available for the program and finals.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Primarily virtual, with in-person APAC finals or showcase events.
facts.International Founder: Yes — companies entering Asia-Pacific may apply
facts.Visa / Relocation: No long-term relocation required; participants must meet entry requirements for APAC finals and events.
facts.Deadline / Next Intake: Applications typically reopen in October for following year
facts.Application Materials: A MedTech Innovator account and company, product, clinical, regulatory, commercialization and funding information.
facts.Public Contact Route: Official application / Contact Us; only trust @medtechinnovator.org or @innovator.org communications.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Early to mid-stage medical device, diagnostics or digital health companies seeking APAC market entry.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Therapeutics-only companies without medtech, diagnostics or digital health products, or without APAC market interest.
facts.Notes: Strong fit for global medtech entering APAC. For a US-only strategy, consider MTI US or VANTAGE.
